messages:
Sofia Martinez: Hey everyone, I just accepted the orientation invite but the event shows 07:00 in my calendar (I'm UTC+7) and there is no Zoom link in the description. Is there a separate APAC invite or did I get the wrong recurrence? :confused:
Onboarding Bot: Hi Sofia! We run two live cohorts for orientation (AMER and APAC/EU). Recording will be uploaded to Confluence after the session: https://confluence.redwood.com/onboarding/recordings. If the Zoom link is missing you likely have the AMER recurrence. Organizer: Ravi Patel.
Ravi Patel: Hi @Sofia  looks like you were added to the AMER weekly series by accident. The APAC slot is "Orientation - APAC/EU (Wed)" at 09:30 SGT. Use this Zoom join link if you need it now: https://zoom.us/j/9876543210
Ravi Patel: Passcode: Redwood-APAC (case sensitive). We'll post slides + recording within 24 hours. The live session includes QA and account setup time.
Sofia Martinez: Thanks! If I can't make the live slot, where will the recording live and how long does it stay up?
Ravi Patel: Recording + transcript will be in Confluence under /onboarding/recordings and also in the "Onboarding Resources" page. Recordings remain for 90 days by default; if you need permanent access DM people-ops.
Maya Liu: Quick accessibility question: can we enable live captions and keyboard accessibility on the call? Who should we contact?
Grace (People Ops): Hi @Maya, email people-ops@redwood.com or DM me. We can enable live captions in Zoom if requested 48+ hours in advance and note any other accommodations.
Sofia Martinez: Outlook shows the event time in UTC and not converting to local time. Any tips?
Ravi Patel: Outlook can be weird with subscribed calendars. Workarounds: 1) Export the single-event ICS and import it into your calendar (don't subscribe). 2) Check File -> Options -> Calendar -> Time zones. 3) Accept the event and confirm the time in the event details in your local zone. If that doesn't fix it, DM me and I'll send a fixed ICS.
Onboarding Bot: Organizer updated event metadata: region=APAC, corrected recurrence. All attendees were re-notified. :white_check_mark:
Sofia Martinez: Imported the ICS into Google Calendar and it shows correctly now  cheers! :thumbsup:
Ravi Patel: Welcome aboard @Sofia. If anyone else is missing the APAC invite, search your calendar for "Orientation - APAC/EU (Wed)" or ping me here and I'll add you to the right series.
